This is the stock market, as a city.
On October sixth, the tech towers stood at a record.
Six weeks later, this is what is left.
Meta, down twenty-four percent. Alphabet, down twenty-four.
And the tallest tower of the AI boom, Nvidia, lost almost half of its height.
About two and a half trillion dollars, gone.
Then, on Thursday, a giant new tower went up. Anthropic.
On its first day, it shot up to one hundred fifteen dollars.
One day later, it sank back to eighty-nine.
And above the city, a storm is building.
Interest rates above five percent. Computers that sell automatically.
So is the AI city falling apart?
Or is this the moment to look for bargains?
Let me know in the comments.
